title: Spread Preference Annotation: Direct Preference Judgment for Efficient LLM Alignment
authors_zh: Dongyoung Kim、Kimin Lee、Jinwoo Shin、Jaehyung Kim（韩国科学技术院、延世大学）
paper_type_zh: 自生成偏好标注与迭代对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合只有少量人工偏好种子、但需要扩展训练记录的读者。
one_line: SPA expands a small preference seed with direct, model-logit preference judgments and noise-aware training.
SPA 用模型 logits 直接标注新生成的回答对，并以噪声感知方式迭代训练。
why: It makes preference-label construction and label-confidence treatment explicit parts of the training pipeline.
inclusion_reason: Expands a small human preference seed into self-annotated pairs that are directly consumed by iterative preference learning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Large human preference collections are costly, while existing automatic labelers can require a stronger model or an external reward model. Generated pairs also carry labeling noise.

SPA asks how a small human-labeled seed can be expanded into usable preference records. It derives pair labels directly from the aligning model's logits and refines uncertain labels during training.

大规模人工偏好集合成本高，而已有自动标注器可能需要更强的模型或外部奖励模型。生成的回答对也会带来标注噪声。

SPA 追问如何将小规模人工标注种子扩展为可用偏好记录。它直接从正在对齐的模型 logits 推导样本对标签，并在训练中细化不确定标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SPA first aligns a policy on a small seed, samples two responses for new prompts, and labels the pair with the policy's direct preference probability relative to its reference model.

It then identifies low-confidence generated labels and softens their training effect. A linearly extrapolated prediction is used to decouple noise detection from the model being updated.

SPA 先在小规模种子上对齐策略，为新提示采样两个回答，再使用策略相对其参考模型的直接偏好概率标记回答对。

随后，它识别低置信度的生成标签，并减弱其训练影响。线性外推预测用于将噪声检测与正在更新的模型解耦。

title: Method
方法
html:
Starting from a seed D0, the model is DPO-tuned, then samples two responses for each new prompt. Its policy/reference logit ratio decides the chosen and rejected response.

The next DPO stage flags the least-confident generated pairs, applies label smoothing to those records, and iterates generation and refinement. The official code implements this procedure.

从种子 D0 开始，模型先接受 DPO 微调，再为每个新提示采样两个回答。其策略/参考模型的 logits 比率决定优选与拒选回答。

下一阶段 DPO 标记置信度最低的生成回答对，对这些记录施加标签平滑，并迭代生成和细化。官方代码实现了这一过程。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On UltraFeedback, the reported seed contains 2K examples, or 3.3% of 60K labels. SPA then uses 8K, 20K, and 30K prompt sets for three expansion stages.

The paper reports an AlpacaEval 2.0 length-controlled win rate increase from 7.58% to 15.39% and MT-Bench from 6.38 to 6.94 for its illustrated setting. These are benchmark outcomes, not a guarantee that self-labels are always correct.

在 UltraFeedback 上，论文报告的种子包含 2K 个样本，即 60K 标签的 3.3%。SPA 随后在三个扩展阶段使用 8K、20K 和 30K 个提示集合。

论文在所展示设置中报告 AlpacaEval 2.0 长度控制胜率从 7.58% 提高到 15.39%，MT-Bench 从 6.38 提高到 6.94。这些是基准结果，并不保证自标注始终正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior expansion methods commonly ask a stronger judge or external reward model to label generated responses. SPA instead turns the policy/reference likelihood contrast into a direct preference judgment.

Its second contribution is confidence-aware refinement of these synthetic records. The work therefore changes how preference labels are constructed and trusted before DPO consumes them.

先前的扩展方法通常要求更强的评判器或外部奖励模型为生成回答标注。SPA 则把策略/参考策略的似然对比转化为直接偏好判断。

第二项贡献是对这些合成记录进行置信度感知的细化。因此，该工作改变了偏好标签在进入 DPO 前如何被构造和信任。

title: Limitations
局限
html: SPA can reinforce the current policy's biases because that policy generates and labels the records it later learns from. Confidence is only a proxy for label correctness, and distribution-shifted prompts can invalidate it. Reuse should audit seed coverage, generated-data duplication, and benchmark overlap.
SPA 可能强化当前策略的偏见，因为该策略既生成又标注之后会学习的记录。置信度只是标签正确性的代理，分布变化的提示可能使其失效。复用时应审计种子覆盖、生成数据重复和基准重叠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use SPA when only a small human preference seed is available and an iterative, model-local expansion method is preferable to hiring a stronger judge. Its code and explicit seed-to-generated-data sequence make the data lineage inspectable.
当只有小规模人工偏好种子，并且更适合使用模型本地的迭代扩展方法而非雇用更强评判器时，应使用 SPA。其代码和明确的种子到生成数据序列使数据谱系可被检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the direct-judgment equation and the decoupled noise detector together: one creates labels and the other decides how cautiously to learn from them. For reproduction, freeze the seed split, prompt sets, model/reference checkpoints, and the confidence fraction before final evaluation.
应将直接判断方程和解耦噪声检测器一起阅读：前者创建标签，后者决定应多谨慎地从中学习。复现时应在最终评估前冻结种子划分、提示集合、模型/参考检查点和置信度比例。
